mapper.sql: resume_id AS resumeId, user_id AS userId, resume_name AS resumeName, is_active AS active, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM auth_users WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM user_resumes WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_active DESC, updated_at DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_resumes ( resume_id, user_id, resume_name, resume_data_json, is_active ) VALUES ( #{resumeId}, #{userId}, #{resumeName}, CAST(#{resumeDataJson} AS JSON), #{active} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_resumes SET is_active = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1
